source: An ZXNAME0000XZ contains multiple execution paths. A floating-point add, integer operation, load/store instruction, special function, and matrix multiply-accumulate are not all serviced by one undifferentiated “core.” Exact pipeline counts and mappings change across ZXNAME0001XZ generations.[1,5,6]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 包含多个执行路径。浮点加法、整数运算、加载/存储指令、特殊函数和矩阵乘法累加并非全部由一个无差别的“核心”提供服务。确切的管道计数和映射在 ZXNAME0001XZ 代之间发生变化。[1,5,6]
